newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averges slightly weaker vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averges slightly weaker vs dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound averaged slightly weaker against the dollar in the private-sector market on Tuesday, bankers said.
Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3950 to 3.3970 bid and from 3.3970 to 3.3990 offered in the interbank market.
"The rate was steady because no one wants to buy (dollars) at these prices," one banker said.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.39595 pounds bid and 3.39775 offered. The averages compared with 3.39525 pounds bid and 3.39725 offered on Monday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.391808 buy and 3.397799 sell.
